iRule(1)						BIG-IP TMSH Manual						  iRule(1)

TCP::naglemode
       Returns setting of Nagle mode.

SYNOPSIS
       TCP::naglemode

DESCRIPTION
       Returns the Nagle mode of a TCP flow.

       Syntax

       TCP::naglemode

RETURN VALUE
       - enabled - disabled - auto

VALID DURING
       ANY_EVENT

EXAMPLES
	# Get the TCP Nagle mode of the TCP flow.
	when CLIENT_ACCEPTED {
	    log local0. "TCP Nagle mode: [TCP::naglemode]"
	}

HINTS
SEE ALSO
CHANGE LOG
       @BIGIP-12.0.0 --First introduced the command.
